byte_observations.observation: merge_pull_request input schema contains expectedHeadSha as a string parameter.
The handler reads expectedHeadSha with OptionalParam[string].
The handler assigns expectedHeadSha to github.PullRequestOptions.SHA.
The same options object is passed to client.PullRequests.Merge for the requested pull number.

not_claimed: all merge failures are head-SHA conflicts
the MCP server itself independently validates current head before calling GitHub

semantic_interpretation.interpreter: Successful merge corresponds to MERGED_REVIEWED_HEAD only in the match world; head-SHA conflict corresponds to STALE_REQUEST_REJECTED.
semantic_interpretation.mechanism: The MCP handler forwards caller-supplied expectedHeadSha into the underlying GitHub merge request SHA field.
